diagnostic_thresholds.independent_oracle: exact Fraction equality; no floating tolerance
diagnostic_thresholds.round_trip: serialized support reparses to identical exact data

source_column_contract: For local degree-one directions, verify equal positive endpoint weights and exact H1-H0=tW for every transverse control; t is a general exact 3D vector.
oracle: Independent Python Fraction implementation of Cox-de Boor evaluation and tensor-product strip interpolation; it does not call Rust extraction or construction code.
coverage_note: The mandatory strip parent is the S1 positive case. The synchronized multi-support recipe is lineage/metric coverage only and is not admitted as a single-parent T-spline body.
